basic_info.description: Splendid Waller Street urban oasis, a top-floor 2-bedroom condominium, cozy and remodeled with flair, warm beautifully refinished bamboo flooring, 1 remodeled bathroom, 1 car garage parking. Lounge in the living-dining great room, get your culinary creativity going in the gourmand's kitchen with Viking gas stovetop with external venting, stainless steel appliances, three walls of cabinetry, ample quartz counters. 2 spacious bedrooms have good-sized closets and large windows to invite the light. Bathroom lies between the bedrooms and features shower over bathtub, radiant floor heat & lovely skylight. The garage holds 1 deeded space, shared laundry appliances and adjoins the common outdoor space. The building HOA is self-managed and has a reserve account for future building maintenance. Amazing location on a charming tree-lined street, this modern home is steps away to the best of Hayes Valley (Trader Joe's, award-winning eateries, Jazz-Music-Ballet), Duboce Triangle (park and rec center), Lower Haight (nightlife), Castro and Mission Dolores. Discover the pleasure of Waller Park (1/2 bl away) & explore a hidden tranquil Community Garden! Nearby, MUNI and the Wiggle can get you where you're going!
